page.content:
Nomad people Zhang Qian was sent to find, later founders of Kushan power.

How Yuezhi connects

  • Character: Zhang Qian — Zhang Qian's brief was to find the Yuezhi as allies against the Xiongnu.
  • Faction: Kushan Empire — Yuezhi groups in Bactria became the Kushan dynasty.

What is Yuezhi?

The Yuezhi, driven from the Gansu borderlands, resettled in Bactria. Zhang Qian's failed alliance with them still mapped the road; their Kushan heirs carried Buddhism east.

Key threads lead to Zhang Qian and Kushan Empire.
